build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run fetch:veriumd:if-missing

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://ipc.localhost https://explorer-vrm.vericonomy.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Modern desktop wallet for Verium (VRM) with a bundled veriumd node, integrated CPU miner, send/receive, transaction history, and chain bootstrap. Connects to a local veriumd over JSON-RPC and is shipped as a single installer.
bundle.copyright: Copyright (c) Vericonomy and the Verium developers
